text:
nina: Onboarding sentry11b-int4 into Dedicated. Canary showed OOMs on long exports (~900-1400 tokens). Logs point to large KV allocations + fragmentation. Anyone have a short mitigation checklist?

jorge: Can you paste a log snippet + the serving.yml you used? my guess: mixing very short and very long requests in same microbatch + lazy compaction.

nina: Log + config: 
```
[2026-05-02T18:14:02Z] req=zx77 model=sentry11b-int4 max_new_tokens=1200 batch_size=4 seq_ctx=64 mem_used=13.1GB kv_delta=+3.9GB
[2026-05-02T18:14:02Z] allocator: slab_frag=0.46 free_slots=10
[2026-05-02T18:14:02Z] gpu2: OOM at kv_alloc serving/allocator/slab.cc:295
[2026-05-02T18:14:02Z] fallback: evict_prefix reclaimed=48MB; retry -> slow success
```
serving.yml: 
```yaml
model: sentry11b-int4
batching:
  max_batch_size: 5
  batch_timeout_ms: 12
  allow_variable_lengths: true
runtime:
  max_new_tokens_default: 1024
  kv_eviction: lazy
  slot_compaction: disabled
```

perf-bot: Canary snapshot: p50=160ms p95=430ms p99=2.3s OOMs=3/1h avg_tokens=560

kim: Quick mitigation I recommend: 1) enable length bucketing to group similar max_new_tokens; 2) lower default max_new_tokens to 400 for int4; 3) enable slot_compaction + eager eviction; 4) add slab_soft_reserve ~400MB.

jorge: I pushed a small patch to the canary at 18:30 (rolled by jorge): 
```yaml
batching:
  max_batch_size: 2
  batch_timeout_ms: 6
  length_bucketing: true
runtime:
  max_new_tokens_default: 400
  kv_eviction: eager
  slot_compaction: enabled
  slab_soft_reserve: 400MB
```

oncall-bot: Deploy sentry11b-int4 v2026-05-02T18:30 by jorge -> pool-dedicated-canary

perf-bot: Update @18:55: p99=1.05s OOMs=0/30m slab_frag=0.32 mem_headroom +1.1GB

kim: Also plan a short quant sweep: int4 vs int8-hybrid on longform summarization. int4 quality tends to drift on >600 token outputs; gating default helps but we should evaluate hybrid.

nina: Ran a quick quality check (250 samples long-form): rougeL gap int4->fp16 = -1.6 pts with new defaults (was -3.0). Latency p95 ~+4% due to compaction. Reasonable tradeoff.

jorge: Action items: 1) Set sentry11b-int4 defaults: max_new_tokens_default=400, max_batch_size=2, length_bucketing=true, slot_compaction=enabled, slab_soft_reserve=400MB, kv_eviction=eager. 2) Add per-route opt-in to allow >400 tokens that routes to fp16 or to a dedicated large-slot pool with warning. 3) Schedule quant sweep (kim + nina) 48h. 4) Add monitor: slab_frag>0.45 OR OOM_count>0 in 15m -> auto-reduce batch caps + alert eng-ml-oncall.

nina: Filed tickets ML-10210 (defaults), ML-10211 (bucketed-batcher RFC), ML-10212 (quant sweep). Canary stable for 1h after patch. I'll drop a short SOP for on-call: if OOMs -> set max_batch_size=1, max_new_tokens_default=128, enable immediate compaction and escalate.

(End)
